title: Benchmarking Evidence Sufficiency in Vision-Language Models for Autonomous Driving
abstract: arXiv:2611.32964v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reliable driving VLMs must do more than answer correctly or localize relevant scene actors: they must determine whether the available visual evidence is sufficient to support an answer. Existing evaluations largely treat grounding and answerability as separate measurements, making it difficult to distinguish well-supported predictions from those localized to relevant but insufficient evidence. We introduce DriveAnswer, a benchmark of 20,151 questions across seven reasoning families, that operationalizes this distinction using matched strong- and weak-evidence configurations. Each pair preserves the underlying scene fact and semantic answer while changing whether the observations support answering, making abstention the appropriate response under weak evidence. On the six-family evaluation, the strongest zero-shot baseline reaches 67.31% strong-evidence accuracy, yet only 21.55% of matched questions satisfy both answer-abstain behavior

translated_title: 自动驾驶视觉语言模型中的证据充分性基准测试
translated_abstract: 可靠的驾驶视觉语言模型（VLM）不仅要正确回答问题或定位相关场景对象，还必须判断现有视觉证据是否足以支持一个答案。现有评估大多将定位能力和可回答性作为独立的测量指标，导致难以区分有充分证据支持的预测与那些仅定位到相关但证据不足的预测。我们提出了 DriveAnswer，一个包含涵盖七个推理类别的 20,151 个问题的基准，通过匹配的强证据与弱证据配置来实现这一区分。每一对配置在保持底层场景事实和语义答案不变的前提下，改变观察结果是否支持作答，使得在弱证据情况下放弃回答成为恰当的响应。在六类别评估中，最强的零样本基线达到了 67.31% 的强证据准确率，但仅有 21.55% 的匹配问题同时满足“回答-放弃”行为。
tldr: 该论文提出 DriveAnswer 基准，通过匹配的强/弱证据问题配置来评估自动驾驶视觉语言模型判断证据充分性并在证据不足时适当放弃回答的能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces DriveAnswer, a benchmark that evaluates vision-language models for autonomous driving on evidence sufficiency judgment and appropriate abstention using matched strong- and weak-evidence question configurations.
